decision: Use the already validated SDL process API through a private RAII adapter. No copied upstream source, dependency upgrade, extra process library or shell command construction.
modifications: Project-owned argv conversion, hidden child ownership, cancellation/reaping and mandatory completion receipt. SDL background mode hides OS exit codes, so a stopped child is not treated as success without a complete result.
validation: Windows background export and actual Studio/D3D11 continue concurrently; Unicode paths, failed child, cancellation and publication protection tested. Apple process adaptation remains unvalidated.
